svg.aria-label: What Atlas can say, and what it cannot say yet
svg.title: What Atlas can say, and what it cannot say yet

text.tspan: 06 THE BOUNDARY
What Atlas can say.
And what it can’t, yet.
SAYS
Treats the plant as one machine
Says what a change might be
Names what would decide it
Stays quiet when it cannot tell
Names the lying sensor, on simulated plants
NOT YET
Close a maintenance alert by itself
needs the work order for that hour
Rank its own alert queue
needs a severity beyond distance
Learn from a labelled command capture
none has been published
Prove itself on a real plant
needs a plant and its operators
From the refusal register: every limit is
written down beside what would lift it.
